scope: Coinbase XRP collateral eligibility, haircuts, wrapped XRP custody/reserves and USDC-backed borrowing

observations.quality: first-party snapshot; not an independent third-party attestation
notes: Coinbase describes cbXRP as a wrapped token backed 1:1 by XRP held by Coinbase.
Page lists underlying XRP reserve addresses on XRPL and cbXRP supply on Base.
The displayed surplus is small and may reflect refresh timing/rounding; do not infer a deliberate overcollateralization policy.

observations.scope: Coinbase Global Exchange perpetual-futures cross collateral
notes: XRP is listed as accepted collateral alongside USDC and other assets.
Per-organization ultimate-beneficial-owner (UBO) average-daily-quantity (ADQ) limits apply; excess collateral above the limit does not contribute to portfolio value.
Collateral value is notional value times collateral weight; greater of base haircut and closeout-horizon haircut applies.
Actual XRP ADQ limit, effective haircut schedule and XRP quantity pledged are not disclosed in the cited page.

observations.scope: X:SM column; Global Derivatives, eligible customers in supported regions outside the United States
notes: The same table shows a dash for XRP in the X:PM column; retain as 'no haircut listed' rather than assume a universal zero haircut.
This 15% applies to the X:SM column of this specific Global Derivatives offering, not automatically to every Coinbase XRP collateral product.
The page says cross collateral currencies can support any cross-margined derivative position.

observations.scope: Coinbase interface to Morpho on Base
notes: Eligible collateral includes XRP; borrowing asset is USDC.
Coinbase provides the interface to Morpho; the loan is enabled by the Morpho onchain lending protocol on Base.
Eligibility: verified US customers excluding New York; limited UK access and Canada availability.
Limits vary by asset and are shown in-product; outstanding XRP-backed loans and total collateral utilization are not disclosed.
Loan proceeds may not be used for trading on Coinbase, per Coinbase terms.
Loan backup table maps native XRP collateral to cbXRP on Base.
Coinbase wrapped-asset documentation says each wrapped asset is backed 1:1 and automatically unwraps when deposited back to Coinbase.
Product specification lists XRP-PERP as linear perpetual, USDC-settled, default initial margin 25%, maximum leverage 50x.
The contract's settlement asset is distinct from the asset pledged as collateral.

relationship_edges.scope_note: Snapshot reserve 152.206M XRP versus 152.203M cbXRP supply; the reserve is backing, not necessarily pledged collateral.
Coinbase says wrapped assets are backed 1:1 by native assets held in custody.
ADQ limits and asset haircuts apply; actual usage unknown.

relationship_edges.to: Morpho on Base through Coinbase interface
relationship_edges.scope_note: Actual loan utilization unknown; New York is excluded from the product's stated US availability.
USDC is the settlement asset; XRP may be the collateral asset. This does not establish Circle as a contract counterparty.

competing_hypotheses.claim: Collateral eligibility and cbXRP wrapping increase XRP's capital utility and may reduce the need for some holders to sell XRP to access dollar liquidity.
supporting: Coinbase accepts XRP as derivatives collateral and as eligible collateral for Morpho-enabled USDC loans.
cbXRP provides a 1:1 wrapped representation on Base.
disconfirming: Actual loan balances, collateral pledges and borrower behavior are not disclosed; eligibility does not equal utilization.
competing_hypotheses.test: Track cbXRP supply, reserve movements, Morpho XRP/cbXRP collateral balances, loan utilization and Coinbase product disclosures.

competing_hypotheses.claim: Collateralization may create reflexive liquidation risk when XRP falls, especially where ADQ limits, closeout haircuts and maintenance-margin triggers constrain collateral value.
supporting: Coinbase documents automatic collateral liquidation and ADQ limits; cross-collateral haircuts apply.
disconfirming: No public aggregate XRP pledge or liquidation data is available for these Coinbase products.
competing_hypotheses.test: Collect synchronized XRP price, collateral balances, haircut/ADQ parameters, margin utilization and liquidation events.

competing_hypotheses.claim: Coinbase's USDC-settled XRP derivatives and USDC borrowing make USDC a financing/settlement layer around XRP collateral.
supporting: XRP-PERP settles in USDC; Morpho loans borrow USDC against XRP; Circle is USDC issuer.
disconfirming: This does not prove Circle directs the products or that USDC settlement increases/decreases XRP spot demand.
competing_hypotheses.test: Measure USDC balances, XRP collateral deposits, cbXRP mint/burn, contract open interest and spot hedging flows.

data_quality: The cbXRP proof-of-reserves page is a Coinbase first-party snapshot, not an independent audit; preserve its displayed refresh time and unknown timezone.
The reserve/supply difference is not proof of a deliberate surplus policy; refresh timing and rounding may explain it.
The 15% XRP haircut applies to the X:SM column of a specific Global Derivatives cross-collateral page effective for most customers from 2026-10-01; do not generalize it to all Coinbase products.
The X:PM dash is recorded as 'no haircut listed', not assumed to be zero.
Global Exchange ADQ limits and greater-of-base/closeout-horizon haircut logic apply, but actual XRP-specific parameters are undisclosed.
USDC loan eligibility and collateral acceptance do not establish outstanding loan balances or utilization.
cbXRP reserve backing is not the same as collateral pledged to derivatives or lending.
next_actions: Capture cbXRP reserve and supply snapshots on a consistent schedule, recording the page's displayed timezone/refresh label.
Track cbXRP mint/burn and Base supply against XRPL reserve addresses.
Seek public data on Morpho XRP/cbXRP collateral balances and USDC loan utilization.
Reconcile Coinbase Global Exchange ADQ caps and closeout-horizon haircuts if official data becomes public.
Keep the Coinbase XRP collateral channel separate from Circle's distribution economics and from direct XRP spot buying.
